name: floating-dock-magnifier
title: Floating Dock Magnifier
description: A desktop navigation dock where individual icon targets scale smoothly using a Gaussian proximity curve as pointer glides across.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Gaussian Proximity Scale: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
